caption:
Solar can cut your Hawaiian Electric bill a lot. It can't take it to zero. On the standard Oʻahu residential rate, the monthly floor is about $32 ($31.62 in Nov 2026). Past that, extra panels mostly pile up credits, and on most export programs unused credits get erased at the yearly reconciliation. Size for your usage and your program, not a $0 promise. Sources on the last slide.

Follow for more plain-English Oʻahu solar math.

#Oahu #HawaiiSolar #SolarPower #HawaiianElectric #Honolulu

slides.text: Solar won't “eliminate your HECO bill.” Here's what's left.

slides.label: a month: the floor on Hawaiian Electric's standard Oʻahu residential rate, even if you use zero power.
slides.sub: $30.22 minimum charge + $1.40 Green Infrastructure Fee = $31.62 (Schedule R, single-phase, Nov 2026).

slides.text: Add panels, the bill drops. Then it hits a floor.

chart.note: Illustrative shape. Floor: Schedule R 1-phase, $30.22 minimum + $1.40 GIF = $31.62 (Nov 2026).

slides.text: So any solar past that ~$32 floor just piles up credits.
And banked credits you don't use get erased once a year.
slides.sub: On SRE Export, NEM, CGS Plus and Smart Export, HECO reconciles every 12 months from your agreement start (not Dec 31). Leftover credits then go to zero.

slides.text: So buying extra panels just to chase a $0 bill can mean paying for credits that vanish.
slides.sub: Size for your usage and your program, not a zero-bill promise.

items: Hawaiian Electric effective rate summary, Nov 2026 (Oʻahu): Schedule R 1-phase minimum charge $30.22 effective ($25.00 base) plus Green Infrastructure Fee $1.40, added to all bills = $31.62.
Hawaiian Electric GIF tariff, Sheets 71/71A: fee applies on top of minimum charges.

Rule 32 SRE Export Rider (Sheets 49.40-I to L): credits only reduce the bill to the minimum plus surcharges; reconciliation every 12 months from agreement start, then leftover banked kWh set to zero; BYOD grid-service credits tracked separately.

Rules 18 (NEM), 24 (CGS Plus), 25 (Smart Export): 12-month reconciliation, unused credits expire. Rule 23 (CGS): unused credits forfeited monthly. Rule 33 (BYOD): grid-service credits carry forward, forfeited at program exit.
